what: how long this repo's per-step unit suite takes, measured rather than assumed
why: a structure pass runs this suite after every structural step, so a suite past about five minutes stops being a per-step check and has to move to the push gate instead. Nobody had measured it.
measuredAt: the structure pass baseline, before the first edit
